name: ACT 50
description: An evidence-led AI Transparency Review Agent that inspects public-facing AI interactions, disclosure quality, synthetic-content signals and Article 50 review questions.

authentication.productionNote: A live deployment requires authenticated task handling.

skills.name: Inspect AI transparency
skills.description: Review public-facing AI interactions, disclosures and observable transparency signals.

skills.name: Find AI interactions
skills.description: Identify candidate chatbots, assistants, voice interfaces and conversational entry points.

skills.name: Review disclosure quality
skills.description: Assess presence, clarity, timing, accessibility and human handover language.

skills.name: Identify public-interest content
skills.description: Flag pages that may require owner questions about AI-generated or materially manipulated text.

skills.name: Inspect machine signals
skills.description: Check inspectable metadata, provenance, structured information and machine-readable labels.

skills.name: Prepare Article 50 review
skills.description: Map observable questions to plain-language EU AI Act Article 50 review areas.

skills.name: Generate transparency recommendations
skills.description: Prioritise evidence-led improvements without issuing legal or compliance verdicts.

skills.name: Request owner input
skills.description: Ask for authorship, editorial-control, responsibility and provider-context information.

skills.name: Request human review
skills.description: Escalate contextual, editorial or legal interpretation to an appropriate human reviewer.

metadata.article50Lens: Article 50 transparency rules apply from 2 August 2026; transitional arrangements may matter for some systems.
